aboutGame.title: What is Groundwork Simulator?
paragraphs: Groundwork Simulator is an open-world heavy machinery game built around excavation, earthmoving, gold prospecting, and gold recovery. You operate excavators, wheel loaders, bulldozers, haul trucks, and trailers across a persistent worksite where every bucket changes the terrain.

The core loop runs from testing a deposit to stripping overburden, cutting paydirt, hauling material, and washing it through sluice boxes and a shaking table. Pumps and hoses keep the plant supplied, while story mode teaches the controls and online co-op lets players split the work.

modules.name: Groundwork Simulator Beginner Guide
modules.description: Learn the essential gameplay loop, from exploring terrain and drilling for gold deposits to excavating soil, transporting materials, and recovering gold. Build a safe first worksite with the tutorial and basic machinery.

highlights.detail: Finish story mode and read the control list before accepting a large job.
Lower camera and arm sensitivity, then dig a flat test patch in open ground.
Scout the site and plan the cut, stockpile, and haul route before moving machines.
Cut in shallow layers and watch hydraulic feedback instead of forcing a full bucket.
Load the truck evenly, lift before swinging, and keep the working face clear.
Test deposits before scaling up and keep the wash plant fed at a steady rate.

modules.name: Groundwork Simulator Gold Mining Guide
modules.description: Locate promising deposits, test the ground, excavate gold-bearing material, and process it through the washing system. Connect the digging face, haul route, pumps, hoses, sluice boxes, and shaking table into one repeatable workflow.

highlights.detail: Test possible dig areas and confirm there is room for digging, loading, hauling, and processing.
Clear overburden and level a work platform before committing the excavator.
Cut the paydirt cleanly and keep the digging face reachable without constant repositioning.
Haul tested material along a short, clear route and avoid overloading one truck.
Feed the wash plant at a steady rate so the sluice boxes can separate the heavier fraction.
Finish the concentrate on the shaking table and keep the recovery stage clear between batches.

modules.name: Groundwork Simulator Vehicles Guide
modules.description: Understand the practical roles of excavators, bulldozers, wheel loaders, and haul trucks. Use this early-game priority ranking to match each machine to digging, access work, stockpile handling, and transport.

highlights.label: S

highlights.label: A
highlights.detail: Bulldozer — Strips overburden, opens access, and grades stable work pads.

highlights.label: B
highlights.detail: Wheel loader — Builds buffer piles and keeps the wash plant hopper fed.

highlights.label: C
highlights.detail: Haul truck — Moves bulk material and pulls the trailer between worksites.

highlights.label: Digger

highlights.label: Hauler

highlights.label: Wash
highlights.detail: Operates the sluice boxes and shaking table at a steady feed rate.

highlights.label: Water

highlights.label: Testing
highlights.detail: Samples ground before the crew commits machines to barren dirt.

modules.name: Groundwork Simulator Controls and Excavation Tips
modules.description: Cover the fundamentals of excavator operation, including bucket angles, hydraulic feedback, digging approaches, and terrain management. Apply practical habits for mud, slopes, and uneven ground.

highlights.label: Boom
highlights.detail: Raise and lower the boom smoothly, keeping the loaded bucket close for heavy lifts.

highlights.label: Arm
highlights.detail: Use the arm for reach and leverage, then retract it when the bucket stalls.

highlights.label: Bucket
highlights.detail: Flatten the bucket to grade; angle it carefully to bite without overloading.

highlights.label: Swing
highlights.detail: Lift before swinging and slow the arc with a full bucket to avoid spillage.

highlights.label: Tracks
highlights.detail: Face uphill or bench the ground before digging on a side slope.

modules.name: Groundwork Simulator Water System Guide
modules.description: Supply the gold washing operation with a reliable pump and hose layout. Run a small test batch, watch sluice flow, and correct water problems before committing to continuous digging.

highlights.detail: Place the wash plant on level ground before routing water or building stockpiles.
Position the pump with a clear intake and a short, inspectable hose run.
Keep hoses out of haul lanes and check connections for kinks or long runs.
Run a small test batch and watch how material moves through the sluice boxes.
Reduce the feed rate if material backs up, then restore water flow before continuing.
Clean the shaking table between batches and keep each recovery step separate.

modules.name: Groundwork Simulator System Requirements
modules.description: Check the official Windows and macOS minimum and recommended specifications for Groundwork Simulator. Plan for the CPU and memory load created by detailed soil and water simulation.

highlights.label: Win Min
highlights.detail: Windows 10, Intel Core i5-8400 or AMD Ryzen 5 2600, 16 GB RAM, GTX 1070 8 GB, DirectX 12.

highlights.label: Win Rec
highlights.detail: Windows 11, Intel Core i5-12400 or AMD Ryzen 5 5600, 24 GB RAM, RTX 3060 or RX 6600 8 GB.

highlights.label: Mac Min
highlights.detail: macOS Tahoe or newer, Apple M4, 16 GB unified memory, and the M4 integrated GPU.

highlights.label: Mac Rec
highlights.detail: macOS Tahoe or newer, Apple M5 Pro, 24 GB unified memory, and the M5 Pro integrated GPU.

highlights.label: Storage
highlights.detail: 10 GB of available space on Windows; plan for the same footprint on Mac.

faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.description: Quick answers to the most common questions about Groundwork Simulator.

items.question: What is Groundwork Simulator?
items.answer: Groundwork Simulator is an open-world heavy machinery game about excavation, earthmoving, gold prospecting, and gold recovery. Players operate excavators, bulldozers, loaders, trucks, and trailers, then wash paydirt through sluice boxes and a shaking table.

items.question: Is Groundwork Simulator multiplayer?
items.answer: Yes. Groundwork Simulator includes online co-op, so a crew can divide excavation, hauling, water supply, testing, and wash-plant operation across the same worksite.

items.question: What should I do first in Groundwork Simulator?
items.answer: Start with Groundwork Simulator story mode, lower the camera and arm sensitivity, and practice a full cut-lift-swing-dump cycle on flat ground. Then test deposits before moving a full mining setup.

items.question: How does gold recovery work in Groundwork Simulator?
items.answer: Groundwork Simulator gold recovery follows a chain: test the ground, strip overburden, cut paydirt, haul it to the wash plant, run material through the sluice boxes, and finish the concentrate on the shaking table.

items.question: Which platforms can run Groundwork Simulator?
items.answer: Groundwork Simulator is available in Steam Early Access for Windows and macOS. The Windows build requires DirectX 12, while the macOS build requires Apple silicon with macOS Tahoe or newer.
